exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: Jack ________ go home early last night.
questions.explanation: 'Last night' indicates past time, so we use 'had to'. 'Have to' is for present. 'Has to' is for third person singular present. 'Last night' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'had to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ brush my teeth twice a day.
questions.explanation: 'Twice a day' indicates a present habitual action, so we use 'have to'. 'Had to' is for past. 'Has to' is for third person singular. 'Twice a day' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်လုပ်ရတဲ့အတွက် 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________ buy another ticket yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates past time, so we use 'had to'. 'Have to' is for present. 'Has to' is for third person singular present. 'Yesterday' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'had to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Susan and Steve ________ pay their rent every Friday.
questions.explanation: 'Every Friday' indicates a present habitual action, and 'Susan and Steve' is plural, so we use 'have to'. 'Has to' is for third person singular. 'Had to' is for past. 'Every Friday' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်လုပ်ရတဲ့အတွက် 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You don't ________ drive today.
questions.explanation: 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Don't had to' and 'don't has to' are grammatically incorrect. 'Today' indicates present. 'Don't have to' ကို မလိုအပ်တဲ့အခါ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: The doctor told her that she ________ lose weight.
questions.explanation: 'The doctor told her' indicates reported speech in the past. In reported speech, 'has to' changes to 'had to'. 'Has to' is for present. 'Have to' is for plural. 'Reported speech မှာ 'has to' က 'had to' ပြောင်းပါ။

questions.question: He ________ see the doctor.
questions.explanation: 'He' is third person singular, so we use 'has to'. 'Have to' is for I/you/we/they. 'Had to' is for past. 'He' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'has to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ learn your language.
questions.explanation: 'She' is third person singular, so we use 'doesn't have to'. 'Doesn't has to' is grammatically incorrect. 'Don't have to' is for I/you/we/they. 'She' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'doesn't have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Children ________ go to school.
questions.explanation: 'Children' is plural, so we use 'have to'. 'Has to' is for third person singular. 'Had to' is for past. 'Children' က plural ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ file reports every week.
questions.explanation: 'Every week' indicates a present habitual action, so we use 'have to'. 'Had to' is for past. 'Has to' is for third person singular. 'Every week' ဆိုတာ ပုံမှန်လုပ်ရတဲ့အတွက် 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Does he ________ go?
questions.explanation: After 'does', we use the base form 'have to'. 'Does has to' is grammatically incorrect. 'Had to' is for past. 'Does' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She didn't ________ attend the presentation.
questions.explanation: After 'didn't', we use the base form 'have to'. 'Didn't had to' is grammatically incorrect. 'Has to' is for third person singular present. 'didn't' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ go to the dentist yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates past time, so we use 'had to'. 'Have to' is for present. 'Has to' is for third person singular present. 'Yesterday' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'had to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You don't ________ drive. I can do it.
questions.explanation: 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Don't had to' and 'Don't has to' are grammatically incorrect. This is a present situation. 'Don't have to' ကို မလိုအပ်တဲ့အခါ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Did they ________ do the work over again?
questions.explanation: After 'did', we use the base form 'have to'. 'Did had to' is grammatically incorrect. 'Has to' is for third person singular present. 'Did' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'have to' ကိုသုံးပါ။
